pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël,
Speak to the sons of Israel,
et dices ad eos:
and you shall say to them:
Mulier,
A woman,
si suscepto semine pepererit masculum,
if she has received the seed to bear a male,
immunda erit septem diebus juxta dies separationis menstruæ.
shall be unclean for seven days, just as in the days of separation due to menstruation.
Et die octavo circumcidetur infantulus:
And on the eighth day, the little infant shall be circumcised.
ipsa vero triginta tribus diebus manebit in sanguine purificationis suæ.
Yet truly, she herself shall remain for thirty-three days in the blood of her purification.
Omne sanctum non tanget,
She shall not touch anything holy,
nec ingredietur in sanctuarium,
nor shall she enter into the Sanctuary,
donec impleantur dies purificationis suæ.
until the days of her purification are completed.
Sin autem feminam pepererit,
But if she will bear a female,
immunda erit duabus hebdomadibus juxta ritum fluxus menstrui,
she shall be unclean for two weeks, according to the custom of her monthly flow,
et sexaginta sex diebus manebit in sanguine purificationis suæ.
and she shall remain in the blood of her purification for sixty-six days.
Cumque expleti fuerint dies purificationis suæ,
And when the days of her purification have been completed,
pro filio sive pro filia,
for a son or for a daughter,
deferet agnum anniculum in holocaustum,
she shall bring to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony,
et pullum columbæ sive turturem pro peccato,
a one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii,
and a young pigeon or a turtledove for sin,
et tradet sacerdoti,
and she shall deliver them to the priest.
qui offeret illa coram Domino,
He shall offer them in the sight of the Lord,
et orabit pro ea,
and he shall pray for her.
et sic mundabitur a profluvio sanguinis sui:
And so she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood.
ista est lex parientis masculum aut feminam.
This is the law for one who bears a male or a female.
Quod si non invenerit manus ejus, nec potuerit offerre agnum,
And if her hand has not obtained or been able to offer a lamb,
sumet duos turtures vel duos pullos columbarum,
she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons:
unum in holocaustum,
one as a holocaust,
et alterum pro peccato:
and the other for sin.
orabitque pro ea sacerdos,
And the priest shall pray for her,
et sic mundabitur.
and so she shall be cleansed.
